answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the sonnet of a task receipt, and the wander is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
